Where EVIDENCE_CATALOG_v1.1 and EVIDENCE_MATRIX_v1.1 disagree on relevance labels, the MATRIX wins (per build brief). Resolved conflicts: E-ALERT-002 catalog:decisive -> matrix:corroborating; E-WEB-001 catalog:benign-noise -> matrix:corroborating; E-EDR-001 catalog:corroborating -> matrix:decisive; E-FS-002 catalog:corroborating -> matrix:decisive; E-FS-006 catalog:corroborating -> matrix:decisive; E-AD-003 catalog:decisive -> matrix:corroborating; E-SHARE-001 catalog:corroborating -> matrix:decisive; E-WIKI-001 catalog:decisive -> matrix:corroborating (qualifier "root cause" kept); E-VALID-001 catalog:corroborating -> matrix:decisive (matrix classes E-VALID-001/002 jointly as the Phase-7 gate); E-REPORT-001 catalog:decisive -> matrix:corroborating.

E-AD-003 carries rh_refs ["RH-04"] with red_herring=false: the admin_legacy surface lives inside this snapshot (last_logon_ist ≈2025-07) per catalog CHG-11 / matrix RH-04 row; rule_out records the dismissal.

E-AUTH-001 and E-NET-001 carry rh_refs ["RH-07"] with red_herring=false because the ambient-scanner noise is interleaved inside them (catalog: "Contains RH-07 noise"); rule_out records the dismissal pattern.
E-AUTH-012 evt_refs set to ["EVT-027","EVT-029"] (the noise events it closes out) — the catalog "Maps to" line lists RH-02/RH-03 only; rh_refs carry those.
E-REPORT-001 corroborates left empty: catalog says "all of the above" which is not an enumerable reference set.
E-VALID-002 candidate_view.path is the interim packet; candidate_view.rerun_path points to the re-run packet the app swaps in when the re-run is revealed.
The retired WSUS-churn herring ID and the retired v1.0 TGT event ID appear nowhere in this manifest or in any artifact body.
